name: lo-fi-hip-hop
title: Lo-fi Hip Hop
description: Slow, relaxed beats with swung drums, jazzy seventh chords and a soft, slightly imperfect feel. Loop-based rather than built on big drops.

structure.description: Keys alone or with a filtered drum loop.
Full beat and the main chord loop; the melody enters after 4 or 8 bars.
Variation: different chords, drums thinned out or a new melody.
Main loop returns with small changes.
Drums drop out or the whole mix is filtered away.

rhythms.name: boom-bap kick
rhythms.description: Laid-back kick: beat 1, the last 16th of beat 2 and the 'and' of beat 3. Vary it every few bars.

rhythms.name: backbeat snare
rhythms.description: Snare or rim on 2 and 4, slightly late for a lazy feel.

rhythms.name: swung hats
rhythms.description: 8th-note hats with a pickup; apply swing to 16ths (music_transform swing, amount around 0.3-0.6, grid 0.25).

rhythms.name: held chords
rhythms.description: One chord per bar, held; humanize timing and velocity.

progressions.description: Jazz ii-V-I turnaround, the most typical loop.
Dorian vamp with a bright major IV.

guidance: Swing and humanize everything (music_transform swing and humanize); perfectly quantized drums sound wrong here.
Seventh and ninth chords carry the mood; voice them close and in the middle register, and keep the bass simple (chord roots).
Keep velocities soft and varied; accents are gentle.
Melodies are short and sparse, often pentatonic, with space between phrases.
Loops repeat for a long time; change something small every 4 or 8 bars instead of building to a drop.
